import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Inspect sample submission columns to understand structure
print(f"Sample submission columns: {sample_sub.columns.tolist()}")


# Text Cleaning function
def clean_comment(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text)
    # Strip surrounding double quotes if present (common in this dataset)
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    return text


train["Comment"] = train["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test["Comment"] = test["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Train/Validation Split (Stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train["Comment"],
    train["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=train["Insult"],
    random_state=42,
)

# Feature Engineering: Word and Character N-grams
# Word n-grams capture semantic meaning
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=20000, min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
# Char n-grams capture spelling patterns and typos
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(3, 6), max_features=20000, min_df=2, analyzer="char"
)

X_train_word = word_vec.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_char = char_vec.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])

X_val_word = word_vec.transform(X_val)
X_val_char = char_vec.transform(X_val)
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

X_test_word = word_vec.transform(test["Comment"])
X_test_char = char_vec.transform(test["Comment"])
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

# Model: LinearSVC with Calibration for probabilities
# LinearSVC is efficient for high-dimensional text data
# CalibratedClassifierCV ensures we get probability estimates for AUC
base_clf = LinearSVC(max_iter=5000, random_state=42, class_weight="balanced")
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="sigmoid", cv=3)

clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Validation
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc}")

# Test Predictions
test_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Prepare Submission
# Instruction: "All predictions should be in the first column of your submission file."
submission = pd.DataFrame()
submission["Insult"] = test_probs

# Add other columns from test set to match sample submission structure (Comment, Date)
# We append them after the prediction column
if "Comment" in test.columns:
    submission["Comment"] = test["Comment"]
if "Date" in test.columns:
    submission["Date"] = test["Date"]

# Save to required path
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
